latest.notes: Fix: the Default Clock safety net / auto-fill can no longer air a wall of commercials. When the log runs dry and the clock's music can't fill (dry rotation), the safety net now falls back to all airable music so the station keeps PLAYING music; it never injects stop sets on their own. Manual 'fill from clock' is unchanged. This is what produced the overnight wall of back-to-back Live365 breaks after a playback stall.
